summary: Avatar with initials on a pixel field coloured from the name, a status dot that pulses when online and a hover ripple.

props.name: name
props.description: Source of the initials (first letters of the first two words), the colour and the accessible name. An empty or blank name shows "Guest".

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the avatar in pixels. The canvas is 6px larger, so the online pulse has room.

props.name: status
props.description: Adds a coloured dot in the lower right corner; `online` pulses.

accessibility: The root has `role="img"` and an `aria-label` with the name, or the name and status, for example "Ada Lovelace, online".
The canvas and the initials are `aria-hidden`, so the label is read once.
motion: With reduced motion the online pulse and the hover ripple are off.
notes: The hue is a hash of `name`, so the same name always gets the same colour in a given theme.

Initials are text in the inherited sans font, sized to the avatar (36% of `size` for two letters, 42% for one), so accented letters render too. They are white, or black on light colours, whichever contrasts more.
Overlap avatars in a stack with a negative margin, for example `className="-ml-[10px]"` on every avatar after the first.
